app.title: IVE — Individual Video Editor
settings.rail_side.hint: The panel always moves to the opposite side.
settings.glass.supported: Glass is supported here. In Auto it stays on and steps down on its own if rendering slows.
settings.glass.unsupported: Glass is not supported here. In Auto the surfaces use a solid tint.
timeline.title: Timeline
placeholder.title: No project open
placeholder.hint: The preview appears here. Media playback arrives in stage 2.
settings.glass_below_safe: Below the level that keeps text legible on a bright frame. Your choice — just know it.
project.name: Project name
project.empty.title: No project open
project.empty.hint: Create one with + in the toolbar, or drop files here.
project.drop_hint: Drag files or folders anywhere in the window
export.filename.hint: Empty = automatic name from the video
export.nothing.title: Nothing to export
export.nothing.hint: Open a video first: the preview is what gets exported.
export.limits: First working version: it re-encodes the video only. Audio and effects are not carried over yet.
timeline.drop_hint: Drag media here to build the sequence
project.drag_hint: Drag onto the timeline to place it
project.open_hint: Pick an .iveproj file, or one of the recent ones below.
proxy.title: Proxies
proxy.hint: 4K is not real-time. Editing runs on small copies; the export always reads the originals.
settings.canvas.hint: Every clip is fitted into this shape. Clips shaped differently get bars.
color.hint: Open a family and drag a preview onto the timeline: the effect covers the clip you drop it on.
color.drag_hint: Drag a preview onto the video track
color.fav_empty: No favorites yet: open a family and tap the star on an effect.
stickers.coming: Stickers are coming soon: animated overlays, shareable as packs, exactly like the colour effects.
sticker.hint: Open a family to browse its stickers. Your own SVG or PNG files installed in user_data/stickers appear here too.
sticker.place_hint: Drag a sticker onto the timeline: it appears centred on the video for the stretch it covers.
sticker.animated_hint: Animated stickers use the open Lottie format and loop on the video. Drop your own Lottie JSON files in user_data/stickers to install more.
text.hint: The title lands at the playhead. Tap it on the video to move, scale or rotate it; tap it on the timeline or the video to edit its words here.
text.font_hint: Every family is shown in its own face. The default follows the application font.
text.handles_hint: Move, scale and rotate the title by grabbing it on the video.
transition.hint: Open a family and drag a transition onto the video track: it snaps to the nearest cut - or to the very start or end of the film, where it plays from and to black. Your own live in user_data/transitions: a greyscale PNG plus a small JSON file IS a new transition.
transition.place_hint: Drag onto the video track near a cut (or at the film's start/end). The white pill shows it: drag its edges to change the duration, tap it and use the trash to remove it.
sticker.fav_empty: No favourite stickers yet. Star a sticker in any family and it gathers here.
transition.fav_empty: No favourite transitions yet. Star a transition in any family and it gathers here.
pack.description_hint: One line about what is inside
pack.contents_hint: Open a category and tick what to include. The files they need (luma maps, SVG, Lottie) travel inside the pack.
pack.none_installed: No packs installed yet. Install one from a file, or drop a .ivepack anywhere on the window.
pack.summary: {c} colours · {t} transitions · {s} stickers · {m} animations · {e} export presets
pack.drop_hint: …or drop a .ivepack file anywhere on the window
pack.duplicates: {n} entries have ids already in your catalogues and will be skipped (nothing is ever overwritten).
pack.already_installed: This pack is already installed. Remove it first to install this file.
pack.safe_note: Data only, no code: installing is safe.
text.motion_hint: Entrances play over the title's first moments, exits end on its last, loops run throughout. Hover a card to see these words move.
